KnowledgeBaseChunk.description_en: The information of a single chunk in a knowledge base document, including the chunk content, sequence number, title path, and enabled status
KnowledgeBaseChunk.description_zh: 知识库文档的单个切片信息，包含切片正文、序号、标题路径与启用状态

ChunkSeq.description_en: The sequence number of the chunk within the document, starting from 1 and numbered consecutively
ChunkSeq.description_zh: 切片在文档内的序号，从 1 开始连续编号
ChunkSeq.title: 切片序号

ChunkSize.description_en: The number of characters in the chunk content, measured in UTF-16 code units, consistent with MaxChunkSize. You can use this value to evaluate chunk saturation against the chunking configuration
ChunkSize.description_zh: 切片正文的字符数，与 MaxChunkSize 同口径（UTF-16 码元数），可用于对照分块配置评估切片饱和度
ChunkSize.title: 切片大小

Content.example: EventBridge 支持将事件路由到多种目标服务。
Content.title: 切片正文

CreatedAt.description_en: The time when the chunk was created
CreatedAt.title: 创建时间

DocumentId.description_en: The ID of the document to which the chunk belongs
DocumentId.title: 文档 ID

Enabled.description_en: Indicates whether the chunk is enabled. Disabled chunks are excluded from retrieval
Enabled.description_zh: 切片是否启用。禁用的切片不参与检索
Enabled.title: 是否启用

FileName.description_en: The file name of the document to which the chunk belongs. This value is from the same source as the FileName returned by GetDocument
FileName.description_zh: 切片所属文档的文件名，与 GetDocument 回显的 FileName 同源
FileName.title: 文件名

SourceLocation.description_en: The location of the chunk in the original document. The format varies by document type: for PDF, the value is p.PageNumber (such as p.3). For PPT/PPTX, the value is s.SlideNumber (such as s.2). For XLS/XLSX, the value is the sheet name. For other formats (such as txt, md, html, doc, or docx), this field is not returned if no source location is available
SourceLocation.description_zh: 切片在原文中的位置，随文档格式不同：PDF 为 p.页码（如 p.3），PPT/PPTX 为 s.幻灯片序号（如 s.2），XLS/XLSX 为工作表名，其余格式（txt/md/html/doc/docx 等）无来源定位时不返回
SourceLocation.title: 来源定位

TitlePath.description_en: The hierarchical title path of the chunk, connected by >. If no recognizable title exists in the original document, the value falls back to a summary of the first paragraph content (such as CONTENT). This field is for display purposes only
TitlePath.description_zh: 切片所属标题层级路径，使用 > 连接。原文无可识别标题时降级为首段内容摘要（如 CONTENT），仅用于展示
TitlePath.title: 标题路径

UpdatedAt.description_en: The time when the chunk was last updated
UpdatedAt.title: 最近更新时间

KnowledgeBaseChunk.title: 知识库切片

description_en: Queries the list of document chunks
name: ListChunks

parameters.help_en: The data catalog to which the knowledge base belongs. This parameter, together with Namespace and KnowledgeBaseName, uniquely identifies a knowledge base. You can call ListCatalogs to obtain this value
parameters.help_zh: 知识库所属的数据目录，与 Namespace、KnowledgeBaseName 共同定位知识库。可通过 ListCatalogs 获取
parameters.name: catalog

parameters.help_en: The namespace to which the knowledge base belongs. The namespace must belong to the specified data catalog. This parameter, together with Catalog and KnowledgeBaseName, uniquely identifies a knowledge base. You can call ListNamespaces to obtain this value
parameters.help_zh: 知识库所属的命名空间，必须属于指定的数据目录，与 Catalog、KnowledgeBaseName 共同定位知识库。可通过 ListNamespaces 获取
parameters.name: namespace

parameters.help_en: The name of the knowledge base. The name is unique within a namespace and is determined at creation time. It cannot be modified
parameters.help_zh: 知识库名称，命名空间内唯一；创建时确定，不可修改
parameters.name: knowledge_base_name

parameters.help_en: Optional. If specified, only chunks of the specified document are returned, sorted by ChunkSeq in ascending order within the document. If not specified, chunks of all documents in the knowledge base are returned, sorted by DocumentId in lexicographic ascending order, and within the same document by ChunkSeq in ascending order, with chunks listed contiguously. In full knowledge base mode, Keyword filtering is not supported (use SearchKnowledgeBase instead), and TotalCount is not returned. Pagination ends when NextToken is empty
parameters.help_zh: 可选。指定时仅列出该文档的切片（文档内按 ChunkSeq 升序）；不传时列出知识库全部文档的切片（按 DocumentId 字典序升序，同一文档内按 ChunkSeq 升序，切片连续排列）。全库模式不支持 Keyword 过滤（请改用 SearchKnowledgeBase），且不返回 TotalCount（翻页终止以 NextToken 为空为准）
parameters.name: document_id

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of results to return per page. If not specified or set to 0, the default value 20 is used. The maximum value is 100
parameters.help_zh: 每页最多返回的数量。未传或传 0 时使用默认值 20，最大值为 100
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: Not required for the first query. For subsequent queries, pass the NextToken returned in the previous response. An empty value indicates that no more pages are available
parameters.help_zh: 首次查询无需传入。后续查询使用上一次响应返回的 NextToken；为空表示没有下一页
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: Optional. Active only when DocumentId is specified. Filters chunks by keyword in the chunk body. Only chunks that contain the specified keyword are returned. In full knowledge base pattern (when DocumentId is not specified), passing this parameter causes an error. To retrieve content across the full text, use SearchKnowledgeBase (set Mode to KEYWORD for full-text index)
parameters.help_zh: 可选，仅指定 DocumentId 时可用。按切片正文关键词过滤，包含该关键词的切片才会返回。全库模式（不传 DocumentId）传入将报错；跨全文内容检索请使用 SearchKnowledgeBase（Mode=KEYWORD 即全文检索）
parameters.name: keyword

parameters.help_en: Optional. Set to true to return only enabled chunks, or false to return only disabled chunks. If not specified, all chunks are returned
parameters.help_zh: 可选。true 仅返回启用的切片，false 仅返回禁用的切片，不传返回全部
parameters.name: enabled

Code.description_en: The response code. A value of Success indicates a successful call. If the call fails, a specific error code is returned
Code.description_zh: 接口返回码，Success 表示成功，失败时为具体错误码
Code.title_en: 接口返回码，Success 表示成功
Code.title_zh: 接口返回码，Success 表示成功

Data.description_en: The chunk list query result, which contains chunk entries and pagination information
Data.description_zh: 切片列表查询结果，包含切片条目与分页信息

items.description_en: The details of a single chunk, including the chunk sequence number, body, title path, and enabled status
items.description_zh: 单个切片的详细信息，包含切片序号、正文、标题路径与启用状态

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of results per page that took effect for this request
MaxResults.description_zh: 本次请求实际生效的单页最大结果数
MaxResults.title_en: 本次请求使用的最大结果数
MaxResults.title_zh: 本次请求使用的最大结果数

NextToken.description_en: The pagination token for the next page (an opaque string). Pass this value as the NextToken parameter in the next request to retrieve the next page. An empty value indicates that no more data is available
NextToken.description_zh: 下一页翻页令牌（不透明字符串），传入下次请求的 NextToken 可获取下一页；为空表示已无更多数据
NextToken.title_en: 下一页令牌，为空表示没有下一页
NextToken.title_zh: 下一页令牌，为空表示没有下一页

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of chunks in the specified document when DocumentId is specified. In full knowledge base mode (when DocumentId is not specified), this field is not returned. Pagination ends when NextToken is empty
TotalCount.description_zh: 指定 DocumentId 时返回该文档的切片总数；全库模式（不传 DocumentId）不返回该字段，翻页终止以 NextToken 为空为准

Message.description_en: The message returned by the operation. The value is Operation success if the call succeeds, or a specific error description if the call fails
Message.description_zh: 接口返回的提示信息，成功时为 Operation success，失败时为具体错误描述

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the call was successful. A value of true indicates success
Success.description_zh: 本次调用是否成功，true 表示成功
